title: The last tourist
logline: Labor Day: the seawall with one tourist left on it, from behind, phone down, looking at the bay the way locals do. The page can't tell anymore. The crow can.

panels.composition: A seawall in September with one person in a fleece sitting on the bench from behind, phone face down beside them, looking at the bay, a crow on the wall looking at them.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall in September with one person in a fleece sitting on a bench seen from behind with a phone face down beside them looking at the bay, a crow on the wall looking at them, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
